title: Exact Border-Rank and Rank Separations for Spin-Factor Jordan Algebras, Matrix Jordan Algebras, and Classical Lie Algebras via Koszul Flattenings and Diagonal-Slice Strassen Commutators
abstract: We determine exact multiplicative border-rank and tensor-rank separations across three canonical families of non-associative algebras: spin-factor Jordan algebras J_D, matrix Jordan algebras Sym_n, and classical Lie algebras so_n and sl_3. First, we completely resolve the spin-factor family for every dimension D >= 3: we prove exact border rank underline_R_C(J_D) = underline_R_Q(J_D) = D + 1 (matching the Koszul p=1 flattening rank D^2 - 1 via an explicit purely rational (D+1)-cube symmetric degeneration over Q(eps)) and exact tensor rank R_Q(J_D) = R_C(J_D) = 2D - 2 (via a 5-line substitution proof and a recursive Pythagorean (3/5, 4/5) symmetric algorithm), yielding an unbounded exact gap R(J_D) - underline_R(J_D) = D - 3 and ratio 2 - 4/(D+1) -> 2. Second, for any d-dimensional commutative algebra over a field K (char K != 2, including R and C) with a non-degenerate symmetric invariant bilinear form, we prove the universal kernel identity [L_A^{-1} L_B, L_A^{-1} L_C](A) = 0 and skew-symmetry of L_A[L_A^{-1} L_B, L_A^{-1} L_C] = L_B L_A^{-1} L_C - L_C L_A^{-1} L_B for every invertible slice L_A, unconditionally capping Strassen's commutator rank at d-1 (d odd) or d-2 (d even). On Sym_n, the identity slice A = I_n reduces to (1/4) ad_{[B,C]} of rank at most d - ceil(n/2), whereas breaking symmetry with A = diag(1,...,n) attains the universal Strassen ceiling for all n = 2..7; at Sym_3 (d = 6, ceiling 8), an exact Q-rank Koszul p=2 certificate (84/10) breaks Strassen's wall to prove underline_R_C(Sym_3) >= 9, paired with an exact 14-cube rational Waring identity for tr(X^3). Third, while Strassen's equations are universally blind to every Lie algebra (ad_X(X) = 0), exact Koszul flattenings establish tight underline_R_C(so_3) = R_Q(so_3) = 5 (with an explicit {0, +-1} 5-product cross-product algorithm), underline_R_C(so_4) >= 8 (R_Q <= 10), underline_R_C(so_5) >= 13 (449/36 at p=2), and a three-tier escalation on sl_3 reaching underline_R_C(sl_3) >= 13 (440/35 at p=3), paired with a 25-product rational 5-cross-product algorithm. All core identities are formally verified in Lean 4.36.0 (20 constructive theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) alongside 16 zero-float SHA-256 certificates and 56 adversarial pytest checks.
